as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Mirrorhall Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

341-489-1621-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

6723-7686-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6723-7686-7730.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6723-7686-7730.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1494-4067-7720-7737.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

907-1558-2638-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-2638-4231-4321.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3991-4681-5686.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2034-2762-3129.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2281-3817-6797.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2781-3967-4681.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

967-3809-3967-6441-7087.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

141-413-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Feign Death triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

856-1379-2438-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-1879-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3591-4444-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
3591-4444-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
3591-4444-5796-6282.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat.

224-2248-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
If the land enters untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

1-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
1-5796-6282.description:
Proceed to your next cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Containment Construct triggers for each card discarded this way. Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve all remaining Containment Construct abilities, if applicable, choosing not to exile anything.
Once the stack has emptied and all players pass priority, you will still be in the cleanup step and thus need to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.

957-1309-2061.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second turn.

2556-2963-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

486-2043-2493-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {8}{U}{U}.
486-2043-2493-4276.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Archaeomancer to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Turnabout to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
If lands you control can tap to proudce at least {9}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which can be used to activate Urza's ability infinitely and/or cast Turnabout choosing its other modes.

3490-3597-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
Juri triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
3490-3597-4050.notes: You can sacrifice Juri to deal infinite damage to any target once you stop the loop.

1434-1694-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Gisela.
Gisela does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents are unable to block flying creatures you control.
You have at least three opponents.
1434-1694-3851.description:
Attack with Gisela.
Gisela's myriad ability triggers, creating a copy of itself for each other opponent that is tapped and attacking that opponent.
Each Gisela deals at least forty-eight combat damage to each opponent.

1636-5250.notablePrerequisites: Merieke Ri Berit does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5250.description:
Tap Merieke Ri Berit to gain control of target creature.
Have a creature enter the battlefield.
Merieke Ri Berit untaps, repeat loop.

198-1358-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator does not have summoning sickness.
Empowered Autogenerator has at least two charge counters on it.
198-1358-4222.description:
Activate Sydri by paying {U}, causing Empowered Autogenerator to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by putting a charge counter and tapping it, adding {U} equal to charge counters on Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
